answer: Each node commits an epoch-locked Blake3 state root over a dedicated 16 GB RAM array seeded by the atlas challenge, then proves possession by opening random slices the verifier names. One honest agent holds 16 GB and answers in under 5 seconds; ten clones must each hold a separate 16 GB array, 160 GB in total, because sharing one array cannot serve ten different roots at once. A wrong slice or a late lotus proof slashes the bond and freezes the identity, while a valid opening releases the reward and anchors the ember record.
